name: Champion of Lore
storyline:
Years after Sayri becomes the Guardian of Latin American Mythology, a distant call for help reaches him — a warning sent by other Guardians across the world.
But before he can answer that call, his own home is attacked.

As Sayri steps out of the mystical library he protects, he witnesses a world under siege: ancient myths brought to life in twisted, unnatural forms. Greek legends, corrupted and fused with elements of other pantheons, spread chaos across the land.

In the midst of this devastation, Sayri encounters Kanna, a young girl caught in the pull of destiny. When her village is threatened, Pachamama herself grants Kanna the power to fight back — not as a warrior born for battle, but as a protector shaped by necessity.

Now reborn as a mentor, Sayri must guide Kanna on her first journey, teaching her how to wield knowledge, myth, and power responsibly.

Together, they set out to uncover the source of the Greek corruption consuming the world — and to stop it before the balance between myths, cultures, and stories is lost forever.
summary: The Guardians have failed. Myths crumble into chaos. Become the Champion of Lore the world needs. Battle through corrupted myths and lost worlds in this turn-based, card-driven tactical adventure forged on hexes and ancient lore.
